Aurum Iodatum.



Iodide of Gold. Au I 3 .



Clinical. ─   Larynx, spasm of. Paresis, senile;
        syphilitic. Syphilis.



Characteristics. ─   This is another unproved gold
        salt brought forward by Hale, and used by him with success in cases of above-named diseases
        where symptoms of the components were present.
